title: Fix: big orders still pay shipping
hints: Try `shipping_fee(60.0)` by hand. Which `if` or `elif` is the first one that is `True`?
Python stops at the **first** condition that matches. `60.0 >= 20` is already true, so the check for 50 is never reached.
Check the biggest threshold first: swap the order so `>= 50` comes before `>= 20` (and swap the return values with them).
